Name: CarrotSword
Author: SomniaDream
Description:
在黑暗隧道增加了一个兑换机
兑换物包括（24自制武器、14原版武器、7原版鞋子、8原版戒指、3原版帽子、5部分家具、2稀有道具）
首次下矿后会收到一个包裹（99胡萝卜）
2.0增加信托基金（年末结算）和爷爷故友信件、3个自制武器
An exchange machine has been added in the dark tunnel
The items for exchange include (homemade weapons, original weapons, original shoes, some furniture, and rare props)
Upon your first descent into the mine, you will receive a package containing 99 carrots
2.0 adds a trust fund (settled at the end of the year), letters from grandpa's old friends, and 3 homemade weapons
